title.fr: Un menu des téléchargements plus net.

introduction.en: Clear finished downloads right from the sidebar, and extensions such as Bitwarden and Web Highlights work as they should.
introduction.fr: Effacez les téléchargements terminés directement depuis la barre latérale, et les extensions comme Bitwarden et Web Highlights fonctionnent comme prévu.

body.en: You can tidy your downloads without opening the Downloads screen. The downloads menu in the sidebar has a Clear link that removes the finished downloads it lists.
body.fr: Faites le tri dans vos téléchargements sans ouvrir l'écran Téléchargements. Le menu des téléchargements de la barre latérale propose un lien Effacer qui retire les téléchargements terminés qu'il affiche.

notes: The downloads menu in the sidebar has a Clear link that removes the finished downloads it lists
The Downloads screen no longer shows a Space for Quick Look hint next to its title
File icons on the Downloads screen no longer show over the page title as the list scrolls
Extensions whose content scripts detect a page's language, or close a port once it answers, such as Web Highlights, now work as in Chrome
Extensions run their updated background code after Lilo or the extension updates, instead of the copy WebKit cached at install, which left Bitwarden's popup loading forever
